<!-- stormworks-research-gap:category:Heat exchange -->
This issue tracks explicit open questions in the [wiki](https://sw-wiki.maxsp.de/parts#heat-exchange).

The quotations below preserve the scope of each source. A resource-only article can lack a formula that a separate native-code investigation has partly recovered. Reconcile those findings before treating every quoted item as wholly undecoded.

## Recorded gaps

**Practical behavior guidance**

> The compartment volume of each exchanger variant was not recovered, so the size advantage cannot be stated as a ratio.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/6/limitations/2`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> The fluid-component update gives every exchanger two internal compartments, A and B. Each update A moves toward B by 0.03·qB/(qA+qB) of the temperature gap and B moves toward A by 0.03·qA/(qA+qB), so heat is conserved and the gap shrinks by a constant fraction regardless of variant. The q terms are capacity values taken from the fluid inside each compartment. The fraction itself does not depend on the variant, so any size advantage must come through q or through-flow; it is plausible that larger variants hold more fluid, but their compartment volumes were not recovered, so that advantage is inferred, not shown.
> 
> Both compartments also leak toward the surrounding temperature by 0.001 per update. Radiators use a separate rule: the compartment moves toward the surrounding temperature by 0.003 × (1 + fan), with the fan term clamped to 0…2.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/6/sections/0/body`

**Practical behavior guidance**

> The unit and per-fluid weighting of the q capacity terms, the update rate, and the filter applied to the surrounding-temperature sample (refreshed every 16 updates) were not recovered. Measure exchanger outlet temperatures at fixed flow to turn the per-update fractions into per-second rates.

- [wiki/data/behavior.json](https://github.com/Chaoscaot/stormworks-wiki/blob/main/wiki/data/behavior.json), `/categories/6/sections/2/body`

## Completion criteria

- Recover the relevant routine or run a reproducible measurement against the identified game build.
- Record equations, units, bounds, assumptions and executable addresses or measurement inputs.
- Update the wiki guidance and its extractor, retaining citations and any remaining uncertainty.
- Add or update an interactive graph when the recovered formula supports one.
- Re-run the relevant source checks and website checks.
title: Heat exchange: decode remaining behavior and formulas
